request.approved_script: One-half plus one-third equals two-fifths. Is that right? Pause and spot the mistake. Adding denominators changes the size of the pieces. Instead, use sixths. One-half is three sixths. One-third is two sixths. Add those equal pieces: five sixths. Try one-quarter plus one-half. The answer is three-quarters. Same unit size, then add the pieces.
